propositions: The code-review extension seam does not dynamically fan project criteria into Pass 1 discovery, nor resolve their eval specs through the code-review solver or route them repository-effectively in Pass 3.

Project criterion routing maps logical `project.<name>` ids to validator-safe physical `code-review-project-<name>` ids, but this mapping is incomplete and prevents activated project criteria from executing end-to-end.

The `project.review-phase-boundaries` criterion must enforce four-phase contract boundaries by emitting only evidence-grounded candidates in Pass 1, validity assessments in Pass 2, deterministic disposition in Pass 3, and non-prescriptive guidance in Pass 4, with no cross-phase directives allowed.
Existing `suggested_fix` support grandfathered as debt; unchanged occurrences are acceptable, but new or expanded Pass-1 remediation directives violate phase boundaries and are findings.
The criterion must be configured with `block_threshold: 0.90` and `blocking_enabled: false` for advisory-only pilot operation until real Gerrit evidence supports a future promotion to blocking mode.
